timeline.summary: The heads of the clan houses gather to swear kinship, and Anafenza receives them at the Amber Throne.
timeline.quote: The houses had elected Anafenza to be khan

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.
